pnpm.//: pnpm 10 blocks dependency lifecycle scripts by default, which is the right default, and reports these three as ignored. None is needed: esbuild's postinstall only links a binary its per-platform package already supplies, @google/genai's preinstall is an echo, and protobufjs's postinstall writes a version-prefix warning to stderr and touches nothing. Listing them records the decision and keeps install output clean. Verified by a clean install followed by the full build and all 85 tests.

scripts.setup:browser: pnpm --filter server exec playwright install chromium
